scripts.check: pnpm format:check && turbo run lint typecheck test build
scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json tsconfig.base.json clients/web services/api packages
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json tsconfig.base.json clients/web services/api packages
scripts.vps:backup: docker compose -f infra/vps/compose.yaml exec -T --user postgres postgres-prod pgbackrest --config=/var/lib/postgresql/pgbackrest/pgbackrest.conf --stanza=mons-prod --type=full backup
scripts.nutrition:check: pnpm nutrition:lint && pnpm nutrition:typecheck && pnpm nutrition:test && pnpm nutrition:test:postgres
scripts.nutrition:lint: uv run --project services/nutrition-ingest ruff check services/nutrition-ingest
scripts.nutrition:test: uv run --project services/nutrition-ingest python -m unittest discover -s services/nutrition-ingest/tests -v
scripts.nutrition:typecheck: uv run --project services/nutrition-ingest mypy --config-file services/nutrition-ingest/pyproject.toml services/nutrition-ingest/titan
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm test:database && pnpm nutrition:check && pnpm generated:check && pnpm mons:check
scripts.mons:build:ios: xcodebuild build -quiet -project clients/ios/mons.xcodeproj -scheme mons -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.mons:check: pnpm mons:test:packages && pnpm mons:build:ios && pnpm mons:test
